newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat lower amid strong stg, dull EU tender.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat lower amid strong stg, dull EU tender.

text.p: LIFFE wheat came down on sterling strength and the anticipation of a lackluster EU tender, traders said.
As holders rolled May forward ahead of tendering, July usurped November's recent position as most active month.
Of a total 857 lots traded, 267 were on July and 226 on May, compared with 216 on November.
July last changed hands at 99.00 stg, 1.60 stg lower and the day's low.
The strength of sterling and sympathy with falls in US markets on Thursday triggered some long liquidation, one trader said.
On barley just 18 lots were traded, all on May, which ended at an unchanged 91.00 stg.
